balls.text: a full toss around off, slashed through covers for four to end the innings on a high
short of length, on-pace delivery. Gowtham just pulls it over deep midwicket for a six
a slower one now. Full outside off. Gowtham too looks to lap it away but fails to connect
full around off. Naveen looks to lap it over but the ball hits the toe end of the bat and rolls in front of him
another yorker. Digs it out towards long-on
full at the stumps. Naveen whips it towards long-off. Was in the air but well short of the fielder
walks at the bowler but Shardul shortens his length. Short of length outside off. Naveen pushes it towards extra cover
a length ball around off. Bishnoi swings across, misses, and the ball hits the top of the off stump
a yorker at the stumps. Bishnoi digs it out towards mid-on, and with both midwicket and mid-on on the boundary line, he comes back for the second
a slower bouncer outside off but too high. Bishnoi fails to connect but it has been called a wide
full but further outside off this time. Pooran throws his bat at it but fails to middle and holes out to wide third man
full and wide, and Pooran gets under it. Opening the face of the bat to send it over deep-backward point for another six
brings up his fifty off 28 balls. A full toss wide outside off and Pooran slashes at it, sends it over deep-point boundary for a six
Narine bowls this one wide outside off. Badoni looks to repeat the shot but gets a top-edge and Shardul from deep midwicket moves to his left to take the catch
full around off. A slog sweep from Badoni this time. Goes aerial and just clears long-on
108kph. Full, just outside off. Badoni moves across and slogs it to the right of long-on for a four
full around off. Pushed it towards covers for one
full around off. Digs it out towards long-off
length ball but way outside off and spinning further away. A wide
length ball down the leg side. Paddles it to the left of short fine leg where a fumble from Suyash allows a single
full outside off. Steered towards deep-backward point
a bouncer from around the wicket. Pooran looks to hook it but it's too high. Another wide
a low full toss outside off - that's the plan. Pooran throws his bat at it, gets It from the outside half of the bat and past short third for four

short of length outside off. Was another slower one but too wide. Pooran misses the cut. KKR, though, want to review it. Replays show it went over the bat but Pooran had moved slightly outside off. So it stays a wide
full in the channel. Pooran goes for the reverse hit behind the stumps but fails to connect
too wide outside off this time. Pooran leaves it alone and picks up a wide
short of length angling towards the batter. Badoni miscues the pull towards the vacant midwicket region
full outside off. Was a slower one at 115kph. Steered towards sweeper cover
full around off. Pushed towards long-on for one
full outside off. Digs it out towards sweeper cover
length ball on the stumps. Opens the face of the bat to pick a single in covers
length ball spinning in from outside leg. Pooran paddles it towards short fine leg and sets off. Badoni sends him back. Suyash fires in the throw and Gurbaz break the stumps but Pooran was just in
low full on the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket
tossed up wide outside off. Badoni looks to dig it out but fails to connect
full on the stumps. Defended from the crease
short of length around off. Pooran picks his gap this time instead of sending it into the stands. Goes back and pulls it between long-on and deep midwicket
a googly. Pooran rocks back and looks to pull it hard but the ball comes slower of the pitch and sneaks underneath the bat
a googly outside off. Goes back and whips it towards square leg
length ball outside off, opens the face of the bat to collect a single behind point
90kph. A length ball around off and angling across. Pooran goes for the pull but ends up under-edging it on the off side
and Pooran welcomes him with a six. A googly outside off and Pooran slog-sweeps it over deep midwicket for an 83-metre six
length outside off. Goes back and late-cuts it behind point for four
full around off. Comes forward and defends
length ball outside off and spinning away. Late-cuts it towards short third
length ball around off and spinning in. Pushed towards covers off the back foot
beaten on the outside edge. A length ball outside off, Badoni pushes at it and misses
on the fuller side of good length. Just outside off. Pooran steers it behind point
a googly this time. Tucked away in front of square leg and picks up two before the fielder runs in from the deep and sends in the throw
a legbreak outside off. Goes for the cut but fails to connect as the ball spins away
a googly around off. Comes forward and defends it on the leg side
length ball around off. Goes for the slog sweep but gets an inside edge dragging it towards deep square leg
length outside off. Pooran was looking to work it towards backward point for a single but gets an inside edge into the turf
full on the stumps and Pooran launches it over the bowler's head. He has moved to 23 off just ten balls
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards deep square leg
length ball around off. 86.3kph. Opens the face to work it towards short third
length outside off. Steered towards backward point
length ball on the stumps. Flicked behind square leg
full around off. Opens the face of the bat to steer it towards point
length ball around off. Pushed on the off side from the back foot
a legbreak outside off. Badoni pushes at it from the back foot, and gets an inside edge into the ground behind the stumps
length ball outside off. Cuts it towards deep extra cover for one
a straight six. Tossed up around off, a googly from Varun and Pooran just smashes it over the bowler's head
short outside off. Pooran rocks back and cuts it behind point for four
length outside off. A tentative poke from Pooran. He played it with soft hand, which means the edge went towards the ground and to the left of diving Rana at first slip

De Kock departs as well. It was full around off, a googly. De Kock went for the slog sweep but got more height on it than distance. Russell moved to his left from deep midwicket, settled under it, and completed the catch by falling on his back
length ball around off. Goes deep and tucks it in front of square leg. He was looking for a second but Rinku attacked the ball to keep it to one
length ball around off. Drops it towards cover-point and picks up a single

Narine strikes in his first over. Bowled at 99.6kph, on a length around leg stump. Krunal goes for the slog sweep but fails to middle it. Rinku runs in to his left and takes the catch near deep square leg
length but way down the leg side. De Kock reverse-hits it towards deep backward point. Had he left it, it would have been a wide
length ball on the stumps. Pushed on the leg side. Krunal was looking for a single but Narine was quick to the ball
length ball outside off. Pushed uppishly towards long-off
short of length outside off, 115.7kph. De Kock mistimes the cut into the ground
full around off. Pushed to the left of mid-off for a quick single
a low full outside off. De Kock slices it towards wide long-off. Only a single, though
called a no-ball for height. Looked like it slipped from Shardul's hand. Was way outside off as well
slower one, full around off. Krunal moves across and flicks it towards long-on
full around off and Krunal goes over mid-off. Didn't hit it from the middle of the bat but got enough on it to just clear the boundary line
length outside off, cuts it towards sweeper cover for one
a quicker one, at 104.5kph. Length outside off, Krunal goes for the cut and gets beaten
length ball outside off. Chopped towards short third
short of length on the stumps. Goes back and pulls it towards wide long-on
length ball on the pads. De Kock pushes at it and gets an inside edge onto the pads
short of length. De Kock goes back and pulls it to the left of long-on where Roy makes a diving stop
length ball around off and spinning away. De Kock finds the point fielder with the cut
length ball around off. Pushed towards mid-on
another short ball, much nastier than the previous one. Much higher as well. Stoinis once again fends at it, gets a glove and the ball lobs towards the flying slip where Iyer takes an easy catch
short ball into the pitch. Stoinis wasn't expecting at and ends up fending at it. A bit of a leading edge onto the body

with the field spread now, Mankad holes out. Was short of length at the stumps. He backed away and went aerial over covers. Didn't get it from the middle of the bat though and Harshit runs in from sweeper cover to take it comfortably
length outside off, cuts it towards sweeper cover
full, slower one outside off from around the wicket. De Kock gets an inside edge onto his pad
full around off, and Mankad goes for the sweep this time. Hits it to the right of the deep midwicket fielder for a one-bounce four
looked like another googly but this time it's too full, around off and middle. Flicked towards deep midwicket
another googly. Mankad isn't picking those it seems. Creates room and looks to hit on the off side. Gets beaten on the inside edge. Gurbaz too fails to stop it and it goes for four byes
shouts of catch but the fielder had no chance. Short of length at the stumps. Mankad goes back and flick-pulls it over short midwicket for four
a googly from over the wicket. Mankad was backing away and looking to go big. Gets beaten and gets hit on the thigh
length ball outside off. Punched towards long-on
full around off. Mankad clears his front leg and smashes it over mid-off. Third boundary of the over. It goes into the LSG dugout where Krunal fields it
a slower one - 117kph. Short of length outside off, Mankad was on the move, looking to flat-bat at but gets an under edge into the surface
length ball outside off. Makes room and crashes it through extra cover for the second four of the over
a bouncer now. 143.kph. Mankad is deep in his crease and attempts a hook but fails to connect
goes for the yorker. Just outside off and slightly misses his length. Pushed towards short midwicket
146.1kph. Short of length around off, Mankad backs away and smashes it through covers. He was on 4 off 8 and really needed this boundary
slightly fuller and a touch straighter. De Kock picks it up and sends it over deep-backward square leg boundary - 76 metres
short, just outside off. De Kock pulls it in front of square leg. Rinku cuts it off after running to his right from deep square leg
wide of the crease again, angling towards the batter who was looking to make room. Pushed towards wide mid-on
135.2kph. Short and bowled from wide of the crease, angling towards the batter. Mankad goes for the pull but is late on it. The ball hits the leading edge and dribbles towards cover-point
length outside off. Goes for the cut and gets beaten. But Arora overstepped there, marginally
length ball outside off. Moves across and almost sweeps it over the vacant square-leg region. Not much power behind it, though
full outside off and wobbling in. Mankad looks to drive and gets beaten
short of length, angling towards the pads. Tucked away towards square leg
143.6kph. Short of length outside off and nipping back to hit the inside edge, which deflects onto the body. Mankad was late on it
147.7kph. A length ball around off. Defended on the front foot

First wicket. A short ball angling towards the bower. Karan goes for the pull but the ball hits him high on the bat and goes straight up. Shardul takes a couple of steps forward from short midwicket and settles under it
short of length angling across. Dabbed towards deep-backward point
Over long-on, into the stands. Full around off, de Kock moves across slightly and launches it for the first boundary of the night
length ball around off from around the wicket. Drop-and-run from de Kock
length ball, starting from well outside off and swinging in to find the inside half of the bat as Karan looks to punch it on the off side. Ends up picking a single towards square leg
full outside off. De Kock pushes at it, and gets a thick outside edge past the first slip
full outside off, de Kock finally gets some bat on the ball. Pushes it uppishly to the left of backward point. A half-stop there means de Kock comes back for the second
length ball outside off. Punched towards backward point for one. Rinku Singh goes for a direct hit but misses. If he had hit, de Kock would have been out
full outside off. Punched firmly but straight towards mid-off
137.1kph. Length ball, much closer to the batter this time. De Kock looks to half-defend, half-punch and gets beaten once more
length ball and lots of width this time. But de Kock fails to connect the cut. He is yet to put the bat on the ball
141.6kph. Fuller this time, once again leaving the left-hander with the angle. De Kock looks to push at it with little foot movement. Gets beaten
length ball angling across. Left alone once more
short of length in the channel. Left alone
Short of length outside off. Good bounce off the surface. Karan steers it towards deep third for a single

Six more, but LSG win by one run! Spare a thought for Rinku. Of course a win wouldn't have taken KKR through, but the guy did all the work possible only for them to fall one short. It was a full toss angling into middle, which he hoicked hard and flat. The fielder at long-on leapt and even got a hand, only for the ball to drop back beyond the rope
four wide of long-off! Ah, Rinku just falls short of what he needed. The ball was full outside off, and he drilled wide of the fielder
the first of three sixes needed! Whipped over deep midwicket. Oh my, that made a ridiculous sound off the bat. Slower ball, angling into his pads off a length. Rinku saw, and sent that flaying
another wide. Dipping full toss wide of off, as Rinku doesn't get bat on ball while stabbing
very well bowled. Low full toss outside off, and whipped to deep midwicket. Rinku doesn't run
good ball. A bouncer fired, as he bowls short on off, with Rinku trying to pull, as the ball was quite high for his liking. Took his eyes off last moment
and it's called wide, even as it looked tight. Yorker length ball wide of off, as Rinku tried to poke but missed
and he gets a single. Backs away, as the ball is full and outside leg. Pushed to long-on

ah, first Rinku is beaten off a slower ball, and then there's a mix-up after which they finally decide not to run. Change of pace on a good length, as the ball shapes away to end outside off and keeps a bit low. Rinku pulls but misses
that is a massive hit! That's Rinku's fifty too. Rinku can do no wrong. Absolutely whips that over deep square, as he gets a length ball on middle and leg. It was there to be hit, and Rinku obliged
shortish ball, angles away to end outside off. Pulled towards deep square, and he finishes the second while panting and diving and tumbling

to deep third now! This goes over the fielder, who was inside the circle. Slower ball, and short in length outside off. It bounced nicely too, even as Rinku waited before ramping it over for four more
drilled to deep extra cover! What a sound that made: the ball was full and outside off, and Rinku crashed that off the middle of the bat to send that racing away
over short third! A top edge, but it doesn't matter. Shortish ball around off, as Rinku skips down and swings while trying to pull, but doesn't time it

low full toss, angling into off. Sliced to point, who gets a hand while diving to his right. And, and... there is a quick throw to the keeper, who breaks the stumps quickly. LSG appeal for run-out, and the third umpire finds Narine well short. The ball had dribbled towards deep third after tickling the point fielder's hands, as the throw arrived bang close to the wicket
and again. He went wide of the crease, and bowled a yorker wide of off, albeit this is given wide after Narine lets it go
yorker and wide of off. Left alone

taken at deep backward square! The longer boundary comes into play, and Thakur fails to clear it. It was a short delivery pitching on middle, and climbing nicely after pitching. Thakur looked to pull, but the bounce got the better of him, as he almost swivelled while pulling. The ball got high on to his bat, and flew towards the fielder
full and wide of off, and drilled to deep third

Rinku is keeping them dreaming! A hard pull over deep square leg, and the crowd is alive again. Short ball angling into middle and off - from the angle of around the wicket - as Rinku rides the bounce

very full on leg, and Thakur misses his flick. Appeal for leg before by the bowler, but turned down. So Yash Thakur Krunal reviews. A wobble-seam ball on a length on leg, which seemed to straighten after pitching. There's no inside edge as Thakur pushes but misses, and the ball hit his back leg. And replays show the ball was pitching outside leg
change of pace again. Full on the stumps, and flicked towards midwicket for a hurried two
good ball. Short and wide of off, but a slower ball. It angles away, as Rinku misses his poke with a flat bat
change of pace, and again a slower ball on a fullish length and wide of off. Dragged to deep point
slower ball. On a good length on off, and swiped to fine leg
now an outside edge on the bounce to short third, where Bishnoi dives forward. Length ball outside off, as Thakur poked at it away from his body
swats at this good length ball wide of off, but gets a bottom edge to the keeper
full again on off, and pushed towards extra cover for a quick single
full and quick outside off. Tapped down

the off stump is gone! Russell was eyeing the leg-side boundary this time, hoicking hard across the line but getting beaten completely. Bishnoi pulled his length back to go on a short of a length around off, as the ball shaped to turn in from outside off. Russell swung early, and had to walk back
six down the pitch! The long-off fielder almost made it to his right though. The ball was full outside off, and quite quick, but Russell was up to it to hammer that back
another dot ball. He is hit on his back thigh, as this googly turns in off a shortish length and he misses his pull
short just outside off, and Russell gets a bottom edge to the off side as he looks to bunt at that
slapped to deep backward point! Beats the man in the deep to his right, as the ball is short and wide of off, and Rinku plays late at that to pocket four
looks to ramp at this shortish ball wide of off, but doesn't connect. Change of pace too from Naveen
fuller ball outside off, and he can only drill that to long-on while mistiming his heave
shortish ball, and wide of off. Russell looks to hack hard at that, but is beaten
length delivery, shaping to come in to end close to off. Pushed to point without any foot movement
stabs this length ball wide of off to point, and they pinch a single
short ball to keep Russell down. Rather, it was a bouncer just outside off, and Russell had to duck
short outside off at 141kph, and pulled very hard to mid-on

juggling catch by Bishnoi! One, two and in at the third attempt. He was placed at point, where Gurbaz skied the ball after trying to loft at this length ball which was slightly wide of off. But Thakur had taken pace off there, and so Gurbaz was beaten. There was no timing, as the ball flew up for Bishnoi to gobble it eventually
very good stop by Badoni running and pulling the ball back from the deep third boundary. Short ball from Thakur, and a pull which is top-edge by Gurbaz

struck on the front pad, and there is half an appeal for leg before, but it's turned down. It was a slower ball, angling in off a length from around off. Gurbaz missed his flick, as the ball dribbled to the off side. Then an overthrow at the bowler's end allowed another run
short of a length outside off. Pulled to deep midwicket

now a miss by Bishnoi, as Rinku pushed down at this full ball on off. Okay, I realise late, but it was a dropped catch, although quite tough to hang on to, as he had to go low to his left while having little time to react to that forcefully-hit shot by Rinku
full on off, and tucked to extra cover. There's an overthrow at the bowler's end, and they pinch another single. Krunal was the fielder there
makes room, as Bishnoi follows by turning this good length ball into leg. Pushed to long-on
length ball outside off, and slapped to deep point
lofted down the pitch! Right over the bowler's head, as Rinku gets into this full ball on off, and clears his front leg to bash that away
full and quick outside off. Driven to extra cover
full on the stumps, and pushed to deep midwicket
turns away late off a length ball, and ends outside off after landing on off. Stabbed to short third
shortish, and sliding in to his front pad but outside leg, as he missed his clip
good length on middle. Clipped to short fine leg's left
length ball outside leg, as he misses his attempted clip. Wide given
good length just outside off. Hacked to deep point
short outside off, and turning away. Swatted wide of long-off to collect two
off the outside edge to short third, as he pushed at this full ball on off
on the bounce to long-off. He lofts this length ball outside off, but doesn't get it away
low full toss on middle, and whipped to deep midwicket
chipped to the right off deep midwicket, as the shortish ball turns into him towards the leg stump
full on leg, and driven to long-on
short outside off, and slapped to deep point

Gone, the spinners keep striking for LSG! Looked like the ball kept low there. Yup, it skidded through off the pitch. Krunal bowled it on the shorter side of a length on middle and leg, as it straightened after pitching, and just zipped through quickly to hit middle stump. Roy wanted to clip across the line but missed, even as the ball kept low and he was done in
short and turning away towards off. Pushed down to long-on
backs away, as the bowler fires full and outside leg. The ball rolls towards point off his pad as he misses his sweep
tossed up, and full on his pads. Flicked to deep midwicket
makes room, as Krunal goes on a length around leg. Turns away, and is dabbed down
low full toss, angling into middle. Jammed out by Gurbaz
short outside off, and punched to long-on
full again on off, and shapes to come into middle. Defended off the inside half of the bat
full on off, and defended down

ballooned to extra cover! That is 100 T20 wickets for Bishnoi too. Even so, signs of the ball stopping on the pitch before coming on to the batter. So Nitish is beaten by the slowness of the pitch, as much as by the delivery itself. It was shortish outside off, and turning away while bouncing considerably. Nitish half-pulled and half-poked, as the ball took off from the top edge
keeps low off a good length outside off, as it is bunted towards extra cover
good length outside off, and turns away. Nitish is beaten on his cut
finally gets the sweep away for four! He has been trying since a long time. Full ball on middle and leg, and crashed between fine leg and deep midwicket
full ball on middle, and nudged towards midwicket
past the outside edge! Full and slower, as this ball outside off turns away to beat the bat, with Nitish trying to poke
fullish ball on leg, and lap swept to fine leg
short on the stumps, and pulled hard to the deep midwicket fielder's right. Good, quick stop by the fielder there
length ball outside off. Pushed to deep point
good length ball turning into his pads. Clipped to short fine's right
swept between the keeper and short fine leg! A little tickle while trying to play at that shortish ball turning down leg. Almost went off the top edge
short outside off, and turns away. Chopped towards short third
full outside off, and driven to deep point to get off the mark
full on off, and reverse swept to short third for a quick single
length ball angling in, as it hits his pad while he tries to flick
full on off, and defended to cover

chipped to extra cover! Simple catch for Bishnoi. Iyer looked to punch at this ball, which was short and turning away. But looked like the stopped before coming on to him, even as it bounced comfortably enough for a back-foot punch. Anyway, Gowtham strikes after a rapid powerplay for KKR
good length ball turning into leg. Pulled to fine leg
fullish ball on middle and leg, and swept to short fine leg
slower this time. Good length outside off, and turns away. Poked towards point for a hurried run
short on off, and finds the square leg fielder with his pull
good length and quick on middle and leg. Tucked to mid-on
full ball on leg. Chipped to deep square leg
short and quick on the stumps. Swatted to long-off
lucky runs to deep third! Roy got a top edge, which flew behind the wicket, as he tried to hoick this full ball on the stumps, while playing across the line
now slapped between point and cover point! Short outside off, and he stayed deep in the crease to cut that late and in the gap
reverse swept over point! Full on leg, as he turns around to crash that ball to the boundary for four more
good attempt by Naveen at fine leg! He was rushing forward, before diving to stop the ball on the bounce. It was on a good length and on leg, as Roy pulled hard
full outside leg, as he tried to sweep but missed, with the ball turning away. Wide called
jumps out, and clips this shortish ball to deep midwicket
short and quick on off. Swatted wide of long-off, as they pinch two
slower, and shorter outside off. He looks to sweep but is beaten
drills the sweep to deep square leg! Full and quick on the stumps, and rammed down hard
shortish outside off, and swatted to extra cover
looks to sweep this much fuller ball just outside off, but misses. The ball shapes to turn away
short on the stumps, and quicker too. Punched back to the bowler
pulled to fine leg on a few bounces. Short from Krunal, hinting to turn into Iyer
length ball on his pads. Flicked to midwicket
good length on middle and leg, hinting to turn away. Swatted to long-off
swept between short fine and square leg! Good length ball on the stumps, and Roy got down early to dispatch that to the fine leg boundary
change of pace, and full ball angling into off. Tucked to wide long-on
ah, it's a dot ball. Naveen slows it down, and bowls on the fuller side of a length outside off. Roy can only push it back to the bowler
hammered to deep point! What entertainment! Shortish ball angling into off, as Roy slapped that to the point fielder's right
bashed down the pitch! Roy is having fun. It was a length ball outside off. But Roy stood with his front leg out of the way, even as he made room while jumping out a bit. Six more!
swiped wide of mid-on! Good length ball, which didn't really get up. It was pitched outside off, and Roy swung across the line to send that rolling
short of a length, and a bit wide of off. Pushed to cover point

clipped behind the wicket! Iyer raking up runs in a hurry. Gets another short of a length ball, which shapes into leg stump. Iyer tucks it late, and places to the right of the short fine leg fielder, who dives in vain
skips down, and pulls for six! That just cleared the rope to go over deep square leg. Short ball again, as it angles into middle and leg. Iyer isn't cramped for room, and swings for six
now it's very full, and angling into his pads. Pushed to mid-on
hacks between point and cover point! Short again from Mohsin, as Iyer rides the bounce of the ball outside off, and cracks it away
walks down, and taps this short delivery around off to deep third
looks to pull this shortish ball around middle and off, but is beaten
